name: voice-room
description: Simple link-based LiveKit voice chat with screen sharing.

scripts.dev:restart: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart livekit-gate api web
scripts.build: npm --workspace @voice-room/web run build && npm --workspace @voice-room/web-vue run build && npm --workspace @voice-room/admin run build
scripts.check: npm --workspace @voice-room/shared run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/api run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/web run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/web-vue run check && npm --workspace @voice-room/admin run check && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-web-palette.mts && node scripts/check-web-vue-styles.mts && node scripts/check-test-source-reads.mts && node scripts/check-type-coverage.mts && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test: npm --workspace @voice-room/shared run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/api run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/web run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/web-vue run test && npm --workspace @voice-room/admin run test && node --test scripts/test/*.test.mts
